operation.name: OSGB36 to WGS 84 (6)
operation.why: OSTN15 grid (EPSG:7710, 1 m) not available offline (no grid file, no network), so used the best applicable one: EPSG:1314, 2 m, area GB onshore and nearshore contains all points.

assumptions: Eastings/northings read as EPSG:27700 OSGB36 / British National Grid, metres, easting first. Inverse BNG projection (conversion) then EPSG:1314.
notes: Round trip back to BNG checked internally: within about 0.001 m (GIGS tolerance 0.006 m). Datum shifts 70-125 m range plausible.
